claims.statement: The guide is designed primarily for formal CHWs who are integrated into the health system, have a structured education pathway and a contract, and are appropriately remunerated and supported.
claims.quote: This curriculum guide is designed primarily for formal CHWs who are integrated into the health system, who have a structured education pathway and a contract, and who are appropriately remunerated and supported.

claims.statement: The guide adopts the principles and structure of competency-based education.
claims.quote: This CHW curriculum guide adopts the principles and structure of competency-based education (CBE).

claims.statement: The guide states that it is designed to be adapted to the needs of different health systems, programmes and contexts.
claims.quote: This competency-based CHW curriculum guide is designed to be adapted to the needs of different health systems, programmes and contexts.

claims.statement: The scoping review that informed the guide's design extracted 236 peer-reviewed articles.
claims.quote: In total, 236 peer-reviewed articles were extracted for inclusion in the scoping review (4).

claims.statement: CHWs from a range of geographical and income settings also reviewed the draft curriculum.
claims.quote: In parallel, CHWs from a range of geographical and income settings also reviewed the draft curriculum.
There are three parts to this curriculum guide.

claims.statement: The guide sets out 25 competencies relevant to all CHWs across all contexts.
claims.quote: There are 25 competencies that are relevant to all CHWs across all contexts, including the breadth of the practice activities in the universal modules and role-specific modules.

claims.statement: The universal modules comprise 11 practice-activity modules and one basic science module.
claims.quote: There are 11 modules oriented to practice activities, and one module relating to the common basic science knowledge required for practice.

claims.statement: The content is organized into six competency domains, 12 universal modules, and four role-specific modules comprising 28 topics.
claims.quote: The content is organized into six competency domains, 12 universal modules (11 practice activities plus one module of basic science knowledge), and four role-specific modules, comprising 28 role-specific topics organized under the four modules.

claims.statement: The guide gives a total duration of 303 hours for the universal practice activities.
claims.quote: Total duration of universal practice activities (hours) 303

claims.statement: Module 1 has a suggested 33 teaching hours, including a minimum of 5 hours of shadowing and 6 hours for the summative assessment.
claims.quote: The total suggested time to complete this module is 33 teaching hours, including a minimum of 5 hours of shadowing and 6 hours for the summative assessment (including 3 hours of practice-based observation).

claims.statement: The basic science module has a suggested total of 60 hours including assessments.
claims.quote: The total suggested time to complete this module is 60 hours, including assessments.

claims.statement: The basic science module should be completed before training on any role-specific content.
claims.quote: It should be completed prior to conducting training on any of the role-specific activity content.

claims.statement: Role-specific content should be selected based on population needs and CHWs' scope of practice in a given context.
claims.quote: Content from the role-specific modules should therefore be selected based on the needs of the population and the scope of practice of CHWs in a given context.

claims.statement: The guide recommends that teaching minimize didactic approaches and use practical, authentic learning methods.
claims.quote: teaching should minimize didactic approaches, and include a diverse array of practical and authentic learning methods suited to the unique needs and contexts of the learners.

claims.statement: Formative and summative assessments are outlined for each module.
claims.quote: Both formative and summative assessments of learning are outlined for each module.

claims.statement: The guide does not itself contain the learning materials or case studies.
claims.quote: While it proposes learning activities that often draw from presentations, case scenarios or role play scenario cards, it does not contain the learning materials or case studies.

claims.statement: The guide recommends that the curriculum be delivered, evaluated and updated as needed, and at least every 5–10 years.
claims.quote: deliver, evaluate and update the new curriculum as regularly as needed (indicated by programme evaluation) or periodically, for example at least every 5–10 years.
